summary: Seal coating driveway with Menards Bestseal 100 Around 10 feet of my driveway was removed by the city last year when they were installing new sewer lines. It was replaced with a concrete apron. Unfortunately the movement and shifting made my driveway develop cracks the width of the drive. I had to fill the cracks and a couple pot holes.
